records.name: Milo Beat
records.biography_en: Milo Beat serves with Street Detail, a patrol police detail assigned to HyperNorm disturbances. The peaked cap is familiar enough to hold onto when a routine encounter becomes a surprise.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Milo Beat looks patiently skeptical even when the briefing has run out of useful instructions.
